normalCensus: Both actual EOFs+terminal raw0+empty stderr+complete bounded newline-ended UTF8 strictly within200ms before parse/observe/quiet/finalize/reap/absence. Source receipt facts are not offline replay of unretained intermediate rows.
knownRefusals: Capacity/timeout/nonzero/stderr/malformed invoke fixed refusal and first prefix. Overcap sentinel byte records violation only; failed never parsed as whole.
exceptionGap: CV2-N1: non-EAGAIN read/poll/setup exception bypasses retain_prefix/finish despite acquired bytes; finally cleanup only.
postPublisherProbeCoverage: Final event contains every actual probe through the last complete census, including after earlier watchdog publication. No more Popen/census after finish; finally only closes/signals retained handles. Event provisional until actual parent raw0+both EOF+wholeelapsed<115 and fresh root all-recorded absence.
taskCoverage: Root task IDs/groups derive earlier watched ownedPids plus watchdogPid plus ALL knownGroups leaders including publisher inserted before snapshot. Exact frozen worker.publish branch7–14 only imports/receives/writes/closes/exits and spawns no child; worker already reaped before publisher launch. Thus actual fixed task paths are covered, not a general arbitrary future publisher-descendant guarantee. Probe IDs use COMPLETE FINAL registry, not earlier snapshot. Unknown later task/closure defeats acceptance; no all-transient-process claim.
publicationFailure: Missing/partial/oversized/late event or failed actual exit/EOF/root receipt remains FAILED/UNKNOWN; no event-only positive inference.
rootReceiptTrust: Pinned administrative root observations must be actual independently reviewed objects/raw process files; booleans/field shape alone are not semantics or public admission.
